findings.summary: The aioson packager drops every folder named 'reports' (DEV_ONLY_DIRS in the installed @jaimevalasek/aioson src/commands/store-system.js, matched at any depth), so the 8 files of src/features/reports/ are missing from the store package. src/App.tsx, src/features/result/ResultPage.tsx and src/features/settings/BrandSection.tsx import them, so vite build in the postinstall of a store install or update fails. Outside this unit's write paths and correction budget: the fix is a frontend-lane rename of the folder (e.g. src/features/report-center) with its imports, then an integration rerun of smoke-store-package.mjs. scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs line 156 detects it (assertPackageContents lists the dropped files).

Full run `node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs` was not executed by this review. It is not part of this unit's Done-when, takes about 5 minutes, and rebuilds release state in the working tree. The implementer's run exited 1 on the packager defect above, and the root cause was confirmed by reading the packager source and the src/features/reports file set. Integration must rerun it after the frontend rename and expect PASS.

A real 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 update of an installation with data through the AIOSON Play (Settings -> Instalar App -> Linkar pasta, or local package) and the green badge were not run: the check needs the Play desktop app, which this environment cannot run.
Stray 1.2 MB packager output left by the implementer's inspection run of `aioson system:package .`. It is outside this unit's write paths and was not deleted by this review. It is safe to delete.

messages.text: Release blocker for AC-ra-54: the store package omits src/features/reports/** (packager DEV_ONLY_DIRS includes 'reports'). Steps: (1) frontend lane renames src/features/reports to a kept name (e.g. src/features/report-center) and updates the imports in src/App.tsx, src/features/result/ResultPage.tsx and src/features/settings/BrandSection.tsx; (2) rerun `node scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs` (about 5 min, needs network, pnpm cache and aioson CLI on PATH) and expect PASS; (3) rerun the remaining phase checks: pnpm build, pnpm test, pnpm test:e2e, node scripts/smoke-boot.mjs, aioson harness:check . --slug=relatorios-e-acompanhamento; (4) real 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 update in the Play with data and the green badge. AC-ra-55 and AC-ra-56 belong to the phase-7-backend-backup unit.

Can the frontend lane rename src/features/reports (8 files) to a folder name the aioson packager keeps (e.g. report-center) and update its importers? The packager drops any folder named 'reports', which breaks the store package build for AC-ra-54. This is a frontend-owned path; this review did not touch it.

scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs rebuilds release 0.1.0 from the current package (it removes the 4 migrations of 0.2.0 and the 2 questionnaire runtime files and stamps version 0.1.0 / schema_version 1 / requires_migration false). If a future release adds migrations, they are applied by the update step automatically; add the name to V2_MIGRATIONS only for a release-specific check.
